description: This file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application. It manages the main UI components including a hero banner, 'Seguí viendo' (Continue Watching) and TV Channels rails, and a top navigation bar implemented with Jetpack Compose. The fragment integrates with a ViewModel to fetch and display content data, handles focus navigation for D-pad interactions, and sets up layout and styling according to design specifications. It also manages loading states and error handling for dynamically fetched data.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Fragment responsible for rendering the home screen, including the hero banner, navigation bar, and content rails. It manages focus, layout, content loading, and error handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the repository and ViewModel instances.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Sets up the entire view hierarchy, including root scroll view, container layout, navigation bar, hero banner, content sections, and loading states.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Handles focus requests and sets up LiveData observers for content states.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes ViewModel LiveData for content loading success, loading, or error states, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays the loading indicator for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays the loading indicator for the TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator for the TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays an error message with an option to retry loading content.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the Continue Watching horizontal list with fetched content items.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV Channels horizontal list with fetched channel data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds a Jetpack Compose-based top navigation bar positioned 18dp from the top, centered horizontally, with initial focus on the search icon.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Creates and configures the hero banner component with specified dimensions and positioning.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates and configures the 'Seguí viendo' section with a title, loading state, and horizontal list of content cards.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates and configures the TV channels section with a title, loading state, and horizontal list.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Utility function to convert density-independent pixels (dp) to pixels.
